name: ghq-plus
title: Ghq Plus
description: A Raycast extension to list and get repositories with ghq.
author: flan

commands.name: list-repo
commands.title: List Repositories
commands.subtitle: ghq
commands.description: Show a list of ghq directories.

commands.name: get-repo
commands.title: Get Repository
commands.subtitle: ghq
commands.description: Clone a repository into your ghq root with ghq get.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: editor
preferences.title: Editor
preferences.description: Application used to open the selected repository with Enter. Optional if a Terminal is set.

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Application used to open the selected repository with ⌘ + Enter (Enter when no Editor is set). Optional if an Editor is set.

preferences.name: ghqPath
preferences.title: Ghq Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the ghq binary (the output of `which ghq`).

preferences.name: cloneWithSSH
preferences.title: Clone Protocol
preferences.label: Clone with SSH
preferences.description: Clone with SSH (ghq get -p) by default. Can be overridden per repository in the Get Repository form.
